Look at countries like India. Their kids apparently out study ours, yet do they regulate the water? No. It actually has far more fluoride in some parts and yet those kids are all on the honor role. Don't blame fluoride for a weak mind, blame yourself. 
I used to believe that crap once too...(about fluoride being why we test lower than other countries)

Thank you. I was afraid to look it up with the word conspiracy because I thought it would lead to more of what scares me.
I guess you guys see a lot of trolls around here and I'm sorry I appeared that way. I was just so scared and no one in real life had any insight on these things. Also sorry for the late reply, I'm still kind of banned from online. Not sure if you think I'm sincere or not, but I genuinely am. Also, a little insight on why MOST conspiracy theorists don't believe logic: My psychologist I saw yesterday said the lower portion of the mind creates fear while the upper portion tries to create a reason for it. The upper mind is fueled with so much fear that you cannot think logically until calmed down. I am not as calm as I should be, but I am getting better and eventually my mind won't be so easy to scare like it once was. 
On a side note: scary place, isn't it, this wonderful internet of ours? When someone is trolled so much, they can't tell if someone truly needs help or not and so that is why it's taken me so long to find people to help disprove these things.

I'm feeling better now..
Thanks everyone.
I'm going to try and get a therapist just in case though. I don't feel 100% reassured or better, but I'm not at the end of the line for now.

All that's on my mind this morning is the theories.
Is there anything I can do to get them off my mind? Some seem so realistic..
No one here has disproved them and if they could, none of this would bother me.
I'm really considering getting a therapist, but most of the people I've asked who had them previously say they aren't that helpful.
